title.zh: 授予Ventura P. Marilao在莱特省Palompon市镇电灯、热力与动力系统特许经营权的法案
title.en: An Act to Grant to Ventura P. Marilao a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Palompon, Province of Leyte
title.orig: An Act to Grant to Ventura P. Marilao a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Palompon, Province of Leyte
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp đặc quyền cho Ventura P. Marilao đối với hệ thống chiếu sáng, sưởi ấm và điện lực tại Thị trấn Palompon, Tỉnh Leyte
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Ventura P. Marilao สำหรับระบบไฟฟ้าแสงสว่าง ความร้อน และพลังงานไฟฟ้าในเทศบาล Palompon จังหวัด Leyte

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1444_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, and to the provisions of the Constitution, there is granted to Ventura P. Marilao, for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat and power system for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and/or power for sale within the Municipality of Palompon, Province of Leyte.

In the event that the grantee shall purchase and secure from the National Power Corporation electric heat and power, the National Power Corporation is hereby authorized to negotiate and transact for the benefit and in behalf of the public consumers with reference to rates.

It is expressly provided that, in the event the Government should desire to maintain and operate for itself the plant and enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender its franchise and will turn over to the Government all serviceable equipment therein, at cost, less reasonable depreciation.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 14, 1956.
